scope: Eligibility for public educational publication in the Rawafid evidence-guides library. This decision does not represent independent clinical peer review or individualized medical approval.

publicationRequest.reason: Materialize the three editorially released sources after merge and dispatch the single complete production publisher.

checks: Arabic title, subtitle and summaries are complete and readable
Every article contains practical steps, observable signals, suggested phrases and an avoidance note
References use HTTPS and point to recognized institutional or professional sources
The content distinguishes education and support from diagnosis and individualized treatment
Safety, privacy, autonomy and escalation boundaries are stated where relevant
No prohibited wording using the Arabic word معاقين is present

releasedSources.reason: Complete AAC home-school implementation, communication-rights, privacy and safeguarding guidance with ASHA, WHO and UNICEF references.
Complete inclusive school-transition planning, communication, safety, participation and review guidance with UNICEF and WHO references.
Complete foundational mental-health literacy, help-seeking and information-quality guidance with WHO references and explicit non-diagnostic boundaries.

limitations: External specialist or clinical peer review has not been claimed.
Public pages must retain the educational disclaimer and urgent-risk escalation language.
Source links and reviewed_at dates remain subject to continuing maintenance.
